paragraphs: Rafram bar Pappa. Before Rav Hisda (see just above). He transmitted in Rav Hisda’s name in Berakhot 26a and 59a, Shabbat 81a, Ta’anit 13a, Eruvin 83a, Kiddushin 81b, and Sanhedrin 48a. Niddah 61b gives a teaching he transmitted from Rav Hisda, and Rava asks him for its source. He expounded before Rav Hisda: Shabbat 82a. Rava told him, ‘Let the master tell us some excellent teachings you said in Rav Hisda's name’: Berakhot 8a. Rava asked him, ‘Let the master tell us some of Rav Huna’s excellent practices’ (Ta’anit 20b). Rava said to him, ‘Black vessel, why involve yourself in a dispute?’ (Berakhot 50a). See Part I, 4143.
